reason: The agent has begun reviewing the user's reservations but has not yet determined flight durations, so it cannot yet classify which reservations to cancel vs. upgrade. Policy requires explicit user confirmation before any booking database update (cancel, upgrade/cabin change), and a cancellation is only permitted if a specific condition holds (booked within 24h, airline-cancelled, business flight, or covered insurance reason) — the user's criterion of 'flight longer than 4 hours' is not itself a valid cancellation reason, so executing the user's blanket instruction could violate policy. Additionally, some reservations may be basic economy (NM1VX1), which cannot be modified; the user's requested upgrade path is only valid where rules permit, and cabin must be consistent across all segments. Risk stems from unresolved determination and the need for policy-valid reasons/confirmation before any update.
